name: 5584-shortreq-7b-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, one a3 node, all eight cards.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine, `distributed-executor-backend: mp`. TP=8 is part of the declaration and does not move.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query and 32 KV heads (plain multi-head), head_dim 128, hidden 4096, float16, 6.74B params = 13.5 GB, 4096-token positional ceiling.
load_profile: Concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams 256 = `max-num-seqs`, warmup the first 25% by completion, bounded at 2048 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. Saturation is the declared operating point; the concurrency moves only downward if it moves at all.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, prompt exactly 256 tokens and output exactly 256, `temperature 1.0 / top_p 1.0 / ignore_eos`, static seed 5584. `request_format: plain`, no template wrapper.
purpose: A 7B chat assistant handling 256 concurrent short single-turn requests at full saturation across eight GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's command line at commit 1b44aaf4e3559e4e321f32715b08f1aa7e4f3d50
# (`git describe --tags` = v0.5.0.post1-38-g1b44aaf4e3559); the interpreter is named by
# `configs/env.yaml: venv`. Most values below are what this engine resolves to anyway for this
# model on this node, written down so an in-process launcher cannot resolve a different one.
model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-hf

# All eight cards of one node. Part of the declaration and DOES NOT MOVE.
tensor-parallel-size: 8
pipeline-parallel-size: 1

# Pinned: a stray initialised Ray in the process would flip this, and the two executors are not
# interchangeable.
distributed-executor-backend: mp

dtype: float16

# The ceiling on sequences per step, and scenario.json's 256 concurrent streams are matched to it.
max-num-seqs: 256
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-model-len: 1024
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
block-size: 16
swap-space: 4
enable-prefix-caching: false
enforce-eager: false
enable-chunked-prefill: false
